correctness.rationale: For each partition, strict-up neighbors form a line graph of the donor/recipient bipartite graph. Clique stars give a good cover with that graph as nerve; the graph is connected. Adding all equal-height vertices attaches cones along connected graph-like links to an inductively simply connected old complex; these attachments are null and give a wedge of 2-spheres. Integral LES yields injections and natural graph-cycle quotient. Each cycle rank equals the stated support-pair count. A tested standalone checker independently corroborates 4507 local cases and their global Euler numbers for sizes <=22, first 25 published ranks, and the q-series through 60; computations do not substitute for proof.
